_comment: Input to L1-design-user-journey-mapper, BOM Phase 4 (Feature Design Package). Journeys and wireframes are ADDITIVE by nature — they land in the FDP's additive/ folder and are never merged into a canonical document. Two inputs per the BOM row: stories.json for scope, personas from vision.md for who the journey is for.

stories.title: Happy-path producer registration
stories.narrative: As a producer, I want to submit my registration with my FBO number so that I can begin the process of listing produce.

acceptance_criteria.summary: well-formed FBO number accepted, held pending-verification
malformed FBO number refused, no record created
missing attestation refused server-side, not client-bypassable

stories.title: Asynchronous FBO verification and its outcomes
stories.narrative: As a compliance-accountable platform, I want a producer's declared FBO registration verified against the competent authority's register so that no unverified party can sell.

acceptance_criteria.summary: valid lookup -> registration valid, evidence recorded, publication permitted
invalid lookup -> rejected, producer notified, publication blocked
lookup timeout -> stays pending and retries, never optimistically valid
duplicate verification delivery -> no second evidence record
external party authenticates via external IdP, no employee-directory credential
role provisioned from onboarding record, no default elevated role
invalid token refused server-side, not client-bypassable

open_questions.question: What happens when a previously verified FBO registration lapses or is revoked after the producer has published listings?
Is the competent-authority register queried live, or is a periodically refreshed copy acceptable?

content.execution_summary: • 2 slices under F1.1; F5.1 carried unsliced.

items.name: Producer
items.descriptor: Small food producer, typically 1-5 people. Sells direct to foodservice buyers.
items.technical_capability: Low — web UI, occasional CSV. An API is a convenience, never the only path.
items.context_of_use: Often on a phone, often outdoors, rarely at a desk. Registration is done once, under mild time pressure, and abandoned easily.
items.regulatory_position: Holds Food Business Operator status. HarvestLink does not.

items.name: Foodservice buyer
items.descriptor: Procurement role at a restaurant, caterer or canteen group.
items.out_of_scope_reason: No Cycle 1 story touches the buyer. Buyer discovery is F2.1, roadmap band 4.

items.name: Distributor / logistics
items.descriptor: Regional distributor with an existing EDI or file estate.
items.out_of_scope_reason: F5.1 provisions distributor roles, but no Cycle 1 story gives a distributor a task to perform.

items.name: Certification / audit body
items.out_of_scope_reason: Evidence read access is INT-PEND-03, not yet scoped.
